summary: Possible typosquat of @solana/spl-token with postinstall script
details: Package name '@solana-labs/spl-toke' closely resembles the legitimate Solana SPL token package '@solana/spl-token' (missing trailing 'n', different scope). The package.json declares a postinstall hook that executes 'node install.js' on install, meaning code will run automatically when an installer adds this dependency. The contents and behavior of install.js were not confirmed in this record, so the install-time payload cannot be characterized definitively. The combination of name confusion against a widely-used Solana ecosystem package and an auto-executing install script warrants human review before allowing it into a build.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
